verdict.rationale: Data residency and retention are fair questions for a fraud-protection SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no regional hosting options and no retention or deletion controls. The sensitive-data protection layer only rejects unwanted sensitive data at the API, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control where fraud data lives and how long it's kept — regional residency options and retention controls that survive a privacy review
